rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=32, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=1, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-20 (FINAL, one knob vs iter-19 best). NUMBERS motion_range(n_bands24,n_outer1,thresh0): 8->hr0.0375, 4->0.0914, 2->0.1305, 1->0.1507(iter-19 BEST, RMSE0.004428 SSIM0.958) -- narrowing the motion search monotonically cleaned the densified residual and TRIPLED+ hr. KEY: n_bands=24 was locked back at iter-12 when motion_range=8 was injecting spurious-match noise (n_bands=32 was WORSE then, hr0.0270<0.0299). Now that the residual is CLEAN at motion_range=1, the band optimum likely shifted HIGHER -- finer bands improve step-1 without the old noise penalty. ONE KNOB: wu_n_bands 24 -> 32 (motion_range/thresh/n_outer locked at iter-19). HYPOTHESIS: if the clean-residual regime lets finer bands help again, n_bands=32 raises hr above 0.1507; if 32 still trails 24 (band noise dominates regardless), 24 is the robust band count and iter-19 (hr0.1507) is the campaign best. Either way this HARD-STOP iter-20 closes the six-box search with both the motion_range descent and the n_bands re-check characterized. Budget: ~seconds.
